_note: Single-source (archaic Old Irish; the Erainn, an old Goidelic stock). Goidelic sub-palette of the Celtic family, in its most archaic register; a law-bound druidic HIGH-KINGSHIP - the Ard Ri at Temair over the province-kings, the noble grades (grad flatha) and the brithem's law below. civ = feudal. Even split Lawful/Neutral. Distinct from the heroic-raider clan Cuchulan: Erainn is settled, archaic and royal (older Old-Irish forms; aub/fid/glend; the ri-coicid provincial kingship). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Old Irish register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Celtic morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_celtic.json theonym_set), never real Celtic gods.

phonology.palette: Archaic Old Irish (Goidelic): older forms with retained -as/-os endings; initial mutation (lenition c>ch, t>th, d>dh); broad vs slender consonants; the Ogham register; theophoric stems are the Celtic morphs (Toran-, Orlann-, Eternan-, Gaian-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; mutation-driven clusters; root-initial stress; archaic vocalism.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic maccu / moccu (of the kindred of) and macc (son of); the fine (kin) and the tuath; the noble grades (grad flatha) order the lords.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|feature|saint](stem) + element: Dun-derg (red-fort), Mag-mor (great-plain), Temair-[name] (royal seat of); maccu-[ancestor] (of the kindred of).

title_ladder.government: feudal (an archaic Gaelic high-kingship: the Ard Ri at Temair over the province-kings, the noble grades (grad flatha) below, the brithem's law binding all)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Archaic Goidelic high-kingship, ascending. Built on the ri-hierarchy: Ri Tuaithe (king of a tuath) duchy; Ruiri (over-king of tuatha) principality; Ri Coicid (king of a fifth/province) kingdom; Ard Ri (high king at Temair) empire over the Ard-rige. Bo-aire (cattle-lord, propertied noble) barony; Aire Echta (border-avenger lord) march; Tigerna (lord) county. The brithem (judge) and ollam (sage) stand outside the ladder. (Rank titles are the real Old Irish register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal + maccu-/macc- (of the kindred of / son of); the fine and a praise-name from the fili; the high-born take a royal style.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the ri-grades carry a fine-name and a fili's praise-name; commoners a patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names from the Celtic deity-morphs + Mael- (devotee-of) / Gilla- (servant-of) / Cu- (hound-of): e.g. Mael-Toran, Gilla-Eternan, Cu-Orlann.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Celtic morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_celtic.json theonym_set) in archaic Old Irish form - never real Celtic gods. Lawful/Neutral: an ordered, law-bound druidic high-kingship. The Lawful keep the sun-and-oath powers and the One above them as the sanction of kingship; the Neutral the Tuath-de (god-kin), the ancestral dead and the sovereignty of the land. The brithem's law and the drui-orders mediate.
religion.the_one: Eternan (< Aeternus; the Ancient One above the god-kin, source of the kingship's right)

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toran (the sun, the just brightness, sanction of kings)
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaian (the enduring land, sovereignty of the soil)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the opposing powers keep their Celtic morphs + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power): Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Fire; Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (sanctuary-grove) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran'; the high-king's great nemed at Temair.
religion.saints_pattern: the Tuath-de (god-kin) and the deified ancestors of the ri-line, honored at the royal cairn and the holy well; the Lawful add 'Noeb [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a sun-wheel above the Lia Fail (the king-stone)
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron spear crossed with a torc

banks_patterns.ships: curach river-craft and royal chariot-names (the Erainn are an inland high-kingship): 'the Grey Steed', 'the Wave-Sweeper', 'the Salmon'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [fine] Fian (warrior-band) / the king's Comlann (champions): 'the Fian of Temair', 'the Red-Branch Comlann'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Salmon of Wisdom', 'The Cauldron of Plenty'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned raths and royal sidhe-mounds: 'the Rath of [name]', 'the Sidhe of [hill]'
